Petitioner has challenged the order dated
25.05.2023, passed by learned Central Adm inistrative
Tribunal, Circuit Bench at Nainital, in Original Application
No. 295 of 2022.

2) By the said order, petitioner's prayer for
change in her date of birth was rejected on the ground
that such prayer cannot be entertained at the fag end of
the service career.
3) We do not find any reason to interfere with the
said order. I t is settled position in law that date of birth
entered in the service record of a Governm ent servant at
the tim e of his / her appointm ent cannot be changed at
the fag end of his / her service career.
4) This aspect has been dealt with by the Hon'ble
Suprem e Court in the case of Kar n at ak a Ru r al
I n f r ast r u ct u r e Dev elop m en t Lim it ed Vs T.P. Nat ar aj a
an d ot h er s, passed in Civ il Ap p eal No. 5 7 2 0 of 2 0 2 1 ,
decided on 21.09.2021. Paragraph No. 10 of the said
judgm ent is reproduced as under :
"10. Considering the aforesaid decisions of this
Court the law on change of date of birth can be
sum m arized as under :
(i) application for change of date of birth can
only be as per the relevant provisions / regulations
applicable;
(ii) even if there is cogent evidence, the sam e
cannot be claim ed as a m atter of right;
(iii) application can be rejected on the ground of
delay and laches also m ore particularly when it is made

3
at the fag end of service and / or when the em ployee is
about to retire on attaining the age of superannuation."
5) Adm ittedly, petitioner m ade request for
change of date of birth in the m onth of July 2020, while
she was due to retire in May 2023. She was appointed
in the m onth of February 1987. Thus the request was
m ade by her 33 years after her appointm ent. I n such
view of the m atter, any interference with the im pugned
order passed by the learned Tribunal, would not be
warranted. Accordingly, the writ petition fails, and is
hereby dism issed.
6) Stay Application (IA No. 01 of 2023) also
stands disposed of.
